about: FULL THROTTLE progression (design v6, 14 Nov 2026): driver levels and XP, the skill tree, the garage, the asset library, the paycheck tuning and per-level data. Written by Tools/spec_to_skills.py from the spec pack; the Unreal build reads it from Content/Data/skills.json. Format 2 replaces format 1 (2.3's four point-bought upgrades): skill points now buy the tree, cash buys the garage.

notes.text: Wreck THE JUGGERNAUT in under 40 seconds
Get through The Toxic Run's triple pipe
GRAVITY CHECK two henchmen at once
TURBO AIR over The Dry Wash and the big wash at Last Chance Gas
Wreck THE BIG DEALER in under 60 seconds (he leaves at 90)

branches.about: guns, missiles, wreckage; the destruction-pay branch

branches.name: GETAWAY

skillNodes.name: Tracer Rounds
skillNodes.desc: Bullets bend up to 4° toward the nearest Syndicate vehicle ahead. Works with every load: standard, AP and HE.

skillNodes.name: Heavy Rounds
skillNodes.desc: Every 4th standard round hits for 2 instead of 1 (≈ +25% gun damage). AP and HE rounds keep their own damage and do not advance the 4-round count.

skillNodes.name: Cluster Missiles
skillNodes.desc: Missile blast radius 46 → 64 px; splash damage 3 → 4. (The missile's direct hit stays 9.)

skillNodes.name: Chain Reaction
skillNodes.desc: A wrecked Syndicate vehicle blows up like a barrel: 4 damage to everything within 60 px (box test: \

skillNodes.name: Scorched Earth
skillNodes.desc: Carnage = 1 + 2.5 × w², cap ×3.0 → ×3.5. Every barrel or drum the player blows up pays +$100 cash on the paycheck, whatever set it off (gun, missile, HE blast, Chain Reaction). (A gun or missile hit on a barrel already scores 50 points.)

skillNodes.name: BIG FINISH
skillNodes.desc: Each DOUBLE KILL or better adds +0.05 to that level's Skill multiplier (max +0.5, added after the rest of Skill is computed). Wrecking the boss pays +$10,000 cash.

skillNodes.name: Quick Hands
skillNodes.desc: Steering rate 9 → 12 a second (≈ 0.11 → 0.08 s to full lock, about 30% faster turn-in). A drift press is remembered 0.25 → 0.35 s.

skillNodes.name: Early Spark
skillNodes.desc: Drift charge marks 0.65 / 1.45 / 2.35 → 0.55 / 1.25 / 2.05 (blue / orange / pink). The charge fills at 0.65 a second, up to 1.2 a second steering into the slide, so pink comes 0.3 to 0.5 s sooner.

skillNodes.name: Nitro Refund
skillNodes.desc: Every near miss refunds 5 turbo; every stunt refunds 10 turbo (capped at the tank size).

skillNodes.name: Hot Release
skillNodes.desc: Drift boosts last 0.55 / 0.95 / 1.45 → 0.70 / 1.15 / 1.75 s. A pink release refills 30 turbo (was 24). A pink drift boost is +320, as fast as turbo, so it can carry the player past the Syndicate and save the tank.

skillNodes.name: Slipstream
skillNodes.desc: Near misses on turbo score ×3 base (300 points; was ×2, 200) and add +1 to the combo. Without it, only wrecks raise the combo; a near miss only resets the 3 s combo timer.

skillNodes.name: ROLLING THUNDER
skillNodes.desc: On turbo or a drift boost, rams cost the player no armor (today 3 each), and the boss is no longer a wall: ramming him hits HIM for 6 instead of shoving the player back for 10 damage.

skillNodes.name: Showboat
skillNodes.desc: Combo timer 3.0 → 3.75 s.

skillNodes.name: Hang Time
skillNodes.desc: Air stunts (BIG AIR, TURBO AIR, RAMP JUMP, TURBO JUMP, ROOF LANDING) +25% points. AIRBORNE KILL 500 → 750.

skillNodes.name: Crowd Pleaser
skillNodes.desc: Style +0.06 per distinct stunt type (was 0.05); cap ×1.75 → ×1.9. RUN DOWN counts as a type.

skillNodes.name: Death Wish
skillNodes.desc: UPSIDE-DOWN KILL 600 → 900; GRAVITY CHECK 600 → 900; LOOP THE LOOP, TURBO LOOP, CORKSCREW, PIPE RUN +20% points.

skillNodes.name: Encore
skillNodes.desc: Combo cap ×5 → ×6.

skillNodes.name: STAR POWER
skillNodes.desc: Hold a ×5 combo for 8 s to start STAR TIME: 6 s in which every wreck also scores as a 300-point stunt and plays in slow motion. Once per scene.

skillNodes.name: Crash Pads
skillNodes.desc: Bump damage −25%: traffic 9 → 7, trucks and buses 14 → 10, a charging rammer 18 → 13, a boss's wall shove 10 → 8. (Scraping the rail does no damage, with or without it.)

skillNodes.name: Pit Crew
skillNodes.desc: Wrenches repair 30 → 45 armor. Missile crates also repair 10 armor.

skillNodes.name: Shake It Off
skillNodes.desc: Henchmen punch for 3 instead of 4, and fall off by themselves after 5 s on the car (counts as a HENCHMAN wreck: points and XP, no stunt).

skillNodes.name: Extra Reel
skillNodes.desc: Film for retakes 3 → 4 reels.

skillNodes.name: Second Wind
skillNodes.desc: Below 25% of max armor: guns fire 20% faster (fire interval ÷ 1.2: stock 0.085 → 0.071 s; applied to whatever interval Gun Barrels set) and the combo timer gets +1 s. Applies to every load.

skillNodes.name: LAST TAKE
skillNodes.desc: Once per level, the wreck that would cost a reel instead leaves the player at 25 armor with 2 s of invincibility; no reel spent. Director: "Keep rolling!"

skillNodes.name: Heavy Foot
skillNodes.desc: Holding SPEED UP adds 20 more speed (470 → 490 su, 146 → 152 MPH; stacks on any Big-Block V8 rank). The turbo punch (instant +90) fires after 0.6 s off the turbo instead of 1 s.

skillNodes.name: Drafting
skillNodes.desc: In the wake of a Syndicate car or the boss (behind it, within 150 px of its tail and 20 px of its line), the turbo refills 15 a second faster. "DRAFT" shows on the HUD. Behind the boss the player is also under his guns and in the path of his barrels.

skillNodes.name: Clean Pass
skillNodes.desc: Leaving a Syndicate car behind without touching it refunds 8 turbo. Near misses count out to 24 px (was 14).

skillNodes.name: Slingshot
skillNodes.desc: Pulling out of a draft and lighting the turbo within 0.5 s fires the punch even if the turbo was on a moment ago; the punch is 60 bigger and its cap 60 higher (on top of the Gearbox values).

skillNodes.name: Ahead of Schedule
skillNodes.desc: SCHEDULE pays $300 a second under par instead of $200; cap $30,000 a level instead of $20,000.

skillNodes.name: OUTRUN
skillNodes.desc: The turbo no longer locks out when the tank runs dry: while still held, it gives half boost (+160) until released.
